question: Approve the DRC-4590 rewrite and milestone correction for writing to Linear, and the eight acceptance criteria and declared surface as implementation's contract.

artifacts.summary: Four scope changes, each measured on the post-4587 tree. The primary-per-tab criterion is a feature request rather than a restyle: a primary action reaches one tab of five, and Course and Decisions emit no button at all, so it is ruled out of scope and filed separately. The no-own-radius criterion is unsatisfiable as written against 24 resting control rules over six corner treatments, so it is enumerated and accepted on its verifier on the precedent DRC-4602 set. The clear-to-drop-draft rename is dropped rather than reversing DRC-4561's shipped ruling. Two compelled test dependencies were found by reading the tests rather than the diff and are declared up front.
